correctness.rationale: Given u,v,q,r with prime support of uv dividing q, gcd(r,uv)=1, u∤v, and σ_s(u)<σ_s(v), gcd(qn+r,uv)=1 for all n≥1; multiplicativity factors the two divisor sums as σ_s(u)σ_s(qn+r) and σ_s(v)σ_s(qn+r). Both divisibility conclusions are equivalent to u|v. For s>0 use (u,v,q,r)=(2,3,6,1); s<0 swap u,v; s=0 use (2,9,18,1), as τ(2)=2<3=τ(9). These cover all real s; independent exact rational enumeration tested each of s=-2,-1,0,1,2 through n=120, supporting but not replacing the symbolic proof.

final_claim: For every real s, Pongsriiam Problem 2 is false: in the proportional case ad=bc one may have σ_s(an+b)<σ_s(cn+d) for every n≥1 yet neither a|c nor gcd(a,b)|gcd(c,d), with explicit triples of quadruples depending on the sign of s.
